say:2:1027502001:1.text: Quit messing around and get out of the way. This is the final location of the Deer Spirit's treasure, not some commoner's fair.
say:2:1027502001:1.source_cn: 别闹了，赶紧把路让开，这里是鹿灵宝藏的最终所在地，不是...

say:3:1027502002:1.text: I've worked hard to get here—I had to deal with that goofy rabbit, and I even almost lost my gemstone...
say:3:1027502002:1.source_cn: 我可是辛辛苦苦一路闯关，不得不跟笨蛋兔子斗嘴，还差点失...

say:4:1027502003:1.text: All you and your buddy did was follow me, and now you want a piece of the pie? That's not how the world works.
say:4:1027502003:1.source_cn: 你带着你的伙伴跟上来就想分一杯羹，世界上可没这种好事哦？

say:5:1027502004:1.text: I didn't follow you! I found it according to the legend!
say:5:1027502004:1.source_cn: 我没有跟着你！我是按照传说找到的——

say:7:1027502005:1.text: Who's she calling a goofy rabbit?!

choice_prompt:8:1027502005.text: Who's she calling a goofy rabbit?!

say:9:1027502006:1.text: I stayed one step ahead to get the treasure, and these two suddenly appeared out of thin air, trying to steal it.
say:9:1027502006:1.source_cn: 你说呢？本来还以为先到一步就能先拿走宝藏，没想到这两位...
say:9:1027502006:1.male: I stayed one step ahead to get the treasure, and these two suddenly appeared out of thin air, trying to steal it.
say:9:1027502006:1.female: I stayed one step ahead to get the treasure, and these two suddenly appeared out of thin air, trying to steal it.

say:10:1027502007:1.text: Wait, are they the other treasure hunters that Big Ears hinted at earlier?!
say:10:1027502007:1.source_cn: ……等等，不会兔耳朵你之前提到的什么竞争者，就是这两个...

say:11:1027502008:1.text: No way! You're the thief trying to steal the Deer Spirit's treasure!
say:11:1027502008:1.source_cn: 才不是！明明是你！是你想盗取鹿灵宝藏！

say:14:1027502009:1.text: Yolanda... don't do this... don't fight with her for me.
say:14:1027502009:1.source_cn: 约兰达……别，别这样……别为了我，和她吵架……

say:16:1027502011:1.text: Billie! Don't get up... just rest, please. I promise you, we won't fight.
say:16:1027502011:1.source_cn: 米利！你……你别起来，在旁边好好休息。我答应你，不吵架...

say:18:1027502013:1.text: I'm a treasure hunter who plays by the rules. I use my senses, intelligence, and agility to get what I want without stealing.
say:18:1027502013:1.source_cn: 我是遵纪守法，凭借嗅觉、头脑和行动力寻找宝物的猎人，才...

say:19:1027502014:1.text: You Wilders have said that the treasure is first come, first serve.
say:19:1027502014:1.source_cn: 你们绿裔的人可是说过，这里的宝物本来就是先到先得——

say:22:1027502015:1.text:
Stop twisting our words!
Lyca clearly stated that it would be Misarte's will as to whoever is worthy of the treasure.
say:22:1027502015:1.source_cn: 不要曲解别人的意思！\n莱卡说的明明是，无论谁能获取，...

say:23:1027502016:1.text: Close enough. But anyway, it doesn't matter.

say:24:1027502017:0.text: Come and have a look at the puzzle—there's nothing, it's just a blank slate.
say:24:1027502017:0.source_cn: 你们倒是来看看这里的谜题——一片空白，什么都没有哦。

say:25:1027502018:0.text: That's strange... the other carvings all had hints of some kind.
say:25:1027502018:0.source_cn: 这可真是怪了……其他雄鹿木雕都有提示，这里不该什么都没有啊。

say:28:1027502019:0.text: There are no signs of erosion... Think, Lorsan, have we missed something?
say:28:1027502019:0.source_cn: 周围也没有风化的痕迹……洛桑，你再好好想想，我们是不是...

choice_prompt:29:1027502019.text: There are no signs of erosion... Think, Lorsan, have we missed something?
choice_prompt:29:1027502019.source_cn: 周围也没有风化的痕迹……洛桑，你再好好想想，我们是不是遗漏了什么。

say:30:1027502020:0.text: How do you think? I bet they were following someone and taking shortcuts.
say:30:1027502020:0.source_cn: 还能怎么来，当然是跟着别人抄近路喽？

say:33:1027502021:0.text: Hey, I already told you! We weren't following you, we actually found this place by following the legend of the Deer Spirit!
say:33:1027502021:0.source_cn: 我、我都说了！我们是根据鹿灵宝藏的传说，确认了最后地点...

say:36:1027502023:1.source_cn: 前两句是在指示雄鹿木雕的位置，中间两句是指寻找宝藏的方...

say:37:1027502024:1.text: So it's with devout hearts that Billie and I have carved our path here!
say:37:1027502024:1.source_cn: 所以，我和米利就是凭借着虔诚之心，一路磨砺才努力走到这里的！

choice_prompt:38:1027502024.text: So it's with devout hearts that Billie and I have carved our path here!
choice_prompt:38:1027502024.source_cn: 所以，我和米利就是凭借着虔诚之心，一路磨砺才努力走到这里的！
